description: This Rust source file defines constants for description length limits used in CLI help, YAML frontmatter, and skill bodies. It also provides a function `truncate_description` that smartly truncates text to a specified maximum length, optionally stripping markdown links. The file includes helper functions for link stripping, sentence boundary detection, and character boundary searches, along with comprehensive unit tests for these functionalities.

methods.name: truncate_description
methods.description: Truncates a description string to `max_chars` using smart boundaries, optionally stripping markdown links.

methods.name: strip_markdown_links
methods.description: Removes markdown-style links `[text](url)` and replaces them with just `text`.

methods.name: find_char_from
methods.description: Finds the index of a target character starting from a given position in a character array.

methods.name: find_last_sentence_boundary
methods.description: Finds the last sentence boundary (period followed by space or end) within a prefix string.

methods.name: rfind_char_boundary
methods.description: Finds the last occurrence of a specified character in a string.
